content: Big-O compares how work grows with input size and ignores constant factors.
A nested scan over all pairs often produces quadratic O(n squared) work.
Compare adjacent elements and swap when the left value is larger.
After each pass, the largest remaining element is fixed at the sorted boundary.
Two pointers move under an invariant so discarded regions never need to be scanned again.
A sliding window maintains incremental state while its left and right boundaries move.
Expand by adding the entering value and shrink by removing the leaving value.
Breadth-first search uses a FIFO queue to process a graph or grid layer by layer.
Mark a cell visited when it enters the queue to prevent duplicate frontier work.
Depth-first search uses a LIFO stack or recursion to follow one branch before backtracking.
A useful software boundary owns one responsibility and exposes an explicit contract to the next layer.
JavaScript runs the current call stack to completion before the event loop schedules queued callbacks.
A CDN edge serves cached content near the client and fetches from the origin on a cache miss.
Primary keys identify rows and foreign keys protect relationships between relational tables.
An image is an immutable layered build artifact; a container is a running process created from that image.
A feature vector represents one example as numeric coordinates that models can transform and compare.
A bounded agent loop turns a goal into a decision, calls an allowed tool, observes evidence, and evaluates the result.
Active technical reading converts a chapter into questions, recall prompts, and small applications instead of copied highlights.
